text:
maria: FYI I saw a regression on long sequences after yesterday's kernel-picker change. seqlen=2048 latency up ~18% on A100.
cheng: ugh. is it picking the small-tile path? that's what caused weird register pressure before.
alex: looks like it. profiler shows we route to Tile16x4 variant for many batches even when batch_size=1.
ryan: did the routing threshold for seq_len get lowered? I remember a tweak to favor smaller tiles for batching.
maria: yes, new heuristic lowered the seqlen cutoff from 1536->1400 to favor batching perf. but for dedicated long requests it backfired.
perf-bot: profile summary (nvprof):
```
Kernel: gen_tile_16x4  (chosen)
sm_efficiency: 72%
occupancy: 0.45
registers_per_thread: 64
local_memory_bytes: 2048
spills: 12MB
Throughput: 4.2 tokens/ms
```
alex: compare with Tile32x2 path that used to be picked:
```
Kernel: gen_tile_32x2
occupancy: 0.78
registers_per_thread: 48
local_memory_bytes: 512
Throughput: 5.0 tokens/ms
```
cheng: so smaller tile eat more regs+smem which reduces occupancy here due to seqlen growth. that explains the slowdown.
ryan: also kv-cache behavior changes with tile shape; smaller tiles thrash the cache lines for large KV, adding mem stalls.
maria: I dumped KV hit stats: hit_rate drops ~6% for the Tile16x4 runs at seqlen>1800.
alex: suggests we need sequence-length dependent routing that's also cache-aware, not just batch-size heuristics.
cheng: proposal: add a per-arch autotune pass that records (seqlen, batch, tile_variant) -> effective_tokens_per_ms and kv_hit_rate. then pick by weighted score.
maria: +1. we should also add a hysteresis so short bursts don't flip too often.
ryan: sanity check: can we push a quick rollback to previous cutoff to mitigate customer impact while we iterate?
infra-bot: rollout patch r1234 queued to canary, target channel=prod-gpu, window=10m.
maria: i'll revert the threshold in canary immediately. in parallel let's design autotune dataset.
alex: autotuner cli for local testing:
```
./scripts/run_autotuner --arch a100 --variants 16x4,32x2,64x1 --seqlens 512,1024,1536,2048 --batch_sizes 1,2,4
```
cheng: metric we should record: tokens_per_ms, kv_hit_rate, smem_bytes, regs_per_thread, occupancy_percent, spill_bytes.
maria: also collect latency p95 and p99; throughput alone hides tail spikes.
ryan: after data we can update kernel-picker table and add a tiny ML model to interpolate between points.
alex: note: be careful with quantized kernels — reg usage differs and affects the same thresholds.
maria: ok. immediate action items: (1) revert cutoff in canary (ryan+infra), (2) run autotuner across seqlens/batches (alex+cheng), (3) add KV hit monitoring to perf dashboards (maria).
ryan: i'll get the rollback in now.
maria: thanks — will follow up with autotune results in this thread. :thumbsup:
